import array, hashlib, json, math, random, subprocess, wave
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=root.parents[2]
ffmpeg=repo/'.wac-local/ffmpeg-setup/portable-curl/ffmpeg-9.0.2-essentials_build/bin/ffmpeg.exe'
rate=48000
source=root/'impulse-noise-marker.wav'
rng=random.Random(24680)
x=array.array('h')
for frame in range(rate*12):
    t=frame/rate
    value=0.002*math.sin(2*math.pi*220*t)
    if 6<=t<6.25:
        value+=0.4*(rng.random()*2-1)*math.sin(math.pi*(t-6)/0.25)**2
    if frame in (4*rate,8*rate):
        value=0.8
    x.append(round(value*32767))
with wave.open(str(source),'wb') as w:
    w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(rate); w.writeframes(x.tobytes())
level='dynaudnorm=f=200:g=11:p=0.85:m=20:s=12,loudnorm=I=-12:TP=-1.5'
chains={'original_raw':'adeclip,highpass=f=80,adeclick,afftdn=nf=-25,agate=range=0.056:threshold=0.0056,'+level,
        'gentle_raw':'highpass=f=60,afftdn=nf=-35:nr=6,'+level,
        'disabled_raw':'highpass=f=80,'+level,'zoom':level}
records=[]
def score(y,lag,step):
    inds=range(round(6.03*rate),round(6.22*rate),step)
    xs=[x[i] for i in inds]; ys=[y[i+lag] for i in inds]
    return sum(a*b for a,b in zip(xs,ys))/math.sqrt(sum(a*a for a in xs)*sum(b*b for b in ys))
for name,chain in chains.items():
    dest=root/(name+'.wav')
    cmd=[str(ffmpeg),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-v','error','-n','-i',str(source),'-af',chain,'-ar',str(rate),'-c:a','pcm_s16le',str(dest)]
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,check=True)
    with wave.open(str(dest),'rb') as w:y=array.array('h',w.readframes(w.getnframes()))
    coarse=max(range(-2400,2401,16),key=lambda lag:score(y,lag,16))
    lag=max(range(coarse-16,coarse+17),key=lambda lag:score(y,lag,4))
    peaks=[max(range(round(t*rate)-2400,round(t*rate)+2401),key=lambda i:abs(y[i]))-round(t*rate) for t in (4,8)]
    rec={'profile':name,'filter':chain,'sample_delay':lag,'milliseconds':1000*lag/rate,'correlation':score(y,lag,1),'impulse_peak_offsets_samples':peaks,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':cmd,'exit_code':result.returncode}
    print(name,lag,1000*lag/rate,rec['correlation'],peaks,flush=True)
    records.append(rec)
summary={'notice':'Synthetic isolated impulse/random marker; no speech/listening. Input and outputs are full12sec mechanics references only. No latency compensation applied.', 'ffmpeg_sha256':hashlib.sha256(ffmpeg.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'ffmpeg_version':subprocess.check_output([str(ffmpeg),'-version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],'cases':records}
text=json.dumps(summary,indent=2).replace(str(repo),' <repo>'.strip()).replace(str(repo).replace('\\','\\\\'),'<repo>')
(root/'summary.json').write_text(text+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
